stem: Which quotation from the article shows that forest bathing could have valuable effects?

options.label: F
options.text: It took me a few minutes to clear out the clutter in my brain, and tune in to the natural world. (paragraph 9)

options.label: G
options.text: The Association of Nature & Forest Therapy plans to train and certify about 250 new guides next year. (paragraph 16)

options.label: H
options.text: There's a growing body of evidence that the practice can help boost immunity and mood and help reduce stress. (paragraph 17)

options.label: J
options.text: Most doctors these days agree that people younger than 60 should aim to keep their blood pressure under 140. (paragraph 20)
